briefdescription.para: The single BatchAA instance that is used to cache AA queries.

detaileddescription.para:
It will not be invalidated over the whole run. This is safe, because:
Only memory writes are removed, so the alias cache for memory locations remains valid.
No new instructions are added (only instructions removed), so cached information for a deleted value cannot be accessed by a re-used new value pointer.
